heart_disease.framing: Coronary heart disease risk from standard clinical features (chest pain type, resting BP, cholesterol, ST depression, etc.) — primary target condition, using QGA-style feature selection + QPSO-style hyperparameter search + real QSVM+VQC

diabetes.framing: Genuinely early/pre-diagnosis - glucose, BMI, age, family history risk factors

genomics.framing: High-dimensional genomics data - illustrates classical ML's curse-of-dimensionality challenge

mias_mammography.framing: Mammography image screening, Swin embeddings treated as tabular features — same QGA+QPSO+QSVM+VQC pipeline as heart disease
